A filled marker ($\bullet$) means two separately compiled runs, which measure recompilation, and an open marker ($\circ$) a single run. In the main study, the CPU ran 6 targets with 2 seeds. In FU10, the second run of the v5e and the v6e covers 20 of 68 targets. Follow-ups (FU) lie outside the pre-registered study, and we specified them after we had read the main results. FU10 and FU11 have OSF addenda registered before their runs.
